verdict.rationale: Docs describe API endpoints for retrieving unprocessed payrolls, creating off-cycle payrolls, and preview/validate flows for contractor payments, plus a platform overview claiming 'process regular and off-cycle payrolls' - suggesting the underlying capability for a review-preview-submit payroll cycle exists. However, most evidence is API/embedded-platform documentation rather than a described single ops-facing UI flow, and community feedback is mixed (praise for ease of use but also reports of payroll mistakes and poor support), so full end-to-end 'one flow' UX isn't clearly substantiated.
